name: kstack
description: The bookended PR loop, portable: task -> worktree -> commits -> PR -> normalized review -> merge-ready handoff. Router + playbooks + the QA finding protocol, plus an MCP server that gives any agent the review-state tools the cloud harness has.

interface.shortDescription: The bookended PR loop for any agent
interface.longDescription: Routes tasks through worktree isolation, PR creation, normalized multi-source review (bug/security/flag findings with mechanism-first triage), and a merge-readiness gate. Ships a zero-dependency MCP server for session context and the findings store.
defaultPrompt: /kstack:loop — route this task through the PR loop
Run the review pass on this PR and normalize the findings
prompts: /kstack:unit — route this task through the PR loop
